info.name: Venta API
info.description:
Venta backend API collection.

## Base URL
All endpoints are under `{{baseUrl}}` (default: `http://localhost:4000/api/v1`).
Service metadata: `GET {{serverUrl}}/` and `GET {{baseUrl}}/health`.

## Quick start
1. Register or Login — accessToken is saved automatically
2. Setup: Menu → Floor Plan → Customers → Promotions (create + activate)
3. Create Order (Full) — pass promotionId for discount
4. Complete order: PREPARING → READY → COMPLETED (loyalty if customerId set)

## Promotions on orders
- Create promotion → PATCH activate → pass promotionId on POST /orders
- PERCENTAGE or FIXED discount applied to subtotal before tax
- Response: discountAmount, promotionTitle, reduced totalAmount

## Loyalty
- Pass customerId on Create Order
- COMPLETED order earns 1 point per $1 (floor of totalAmount after discount)

Refresh/Logout use the httpOnly refresh cookie from Register/Login.

request.description:
All create-order fields:
- source: STAFF_ASSISTED | QR_CUSTOMER
- tableId (optional): links order to floor table → marks OCCUPIED
- customerId (optional): links customer → earns loyalty on COMPLETED
- promotionId (optional): apply active promotion — must be activated and within start/end dates
- notes: order-level notes
- taxRate / serviceRate: override business defaults (0 tax by default, 0 service)
- items[].menuItemId, quantity, modifierOptionIds[], customizationNotes

Promotion: discount applied to subtotal before tax. Response includes discountAmount, promotionTitle.
